[SWS_V2xM_00202] ⌈The function V2xM_Vdp_GetNextLongTermCertificate-
ExpirationDate shall check for the currently used long-term certificate (aka. Enrol-
ment Credentials (EC)). If none was found, the function shall return E_NOT_OK. If a
long-term certificate is in use, the expiration date of this certificate shall be provided
through the parameter ExpirationDate and the function shall return E_OK.⌋
